row: Jacki has had a passion and love for horses, and has been involved with them her whole life.   Her and her husband, Jim,  run a 60 + year Quarter horse breeding program.   Her husband is also a professional cutting horse trainer, with almost two hundred thousand dollars in earnings, and is a NCHA judge as well.   Jacki has always been an avid learner and loves to study anything and everything about horses, while basing that knowledge on real life experiences.   She has won money or earned points in all kinds of disciplines including, cutting, barrel racing, team sorting/penning, extreme trail, and ranch riding.   She is also a certified equine massage therapist.  For many years now she has taught classes on subjects such as ground work, equine psychology, color genetics, and massage.   Most of all, Jacki loves to share how God uses horses to teach us about Him, and about ourselves.
